facts.fact: Meta's apps (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and Threads) reach an average of 3.56 billion daily active people, according to the page.
facts.quote: reach an average of 3.56 billion daily active people

facts.fact: Meta organizes campaign objectives into six outcome-driven goals: Awareness, Traffic, Engagement, Leads, App promotion, and Sales.
facts.quote: Meta organizes these into six outcome-driven goals

facts.fact: Meta merged its manual and AI-driven campaign flows into a single interface in early 2026, with AI optimization for audience, placements, and budget on by default for every new campaign.
facts.quote: AI optimization for audience, placements, and budget is now on by default for every new campaign

facts.fact: More than 4 million advertisers use Meta's generative AI creative tools, a figure the page says grew roughly fourfold in six months.
facts.quote: more than 4 million advertisers now use Meta's generative AI creative tools, up roughly fourfold in six months

facts.fact: According to WordStream and LocalIQ benchmarks, the average cost per click for Facebook traffic campaigns is around $0.70.
facts.quote: Average cost per click (traffic campaigns):** around $0.70

facts.fact: According to WordStream and LocalIQ benchmarks, the average cost per click for Facebook leads campaigns is around $1.92.
facts.quote: Average cost per click (leads campaigns):** around $1.92

facts.fact: According to WordStream and LocalIQ benchmarks, the average cost per lead on Facebook is around $27.66.
According to the page, the average CPM for Facebook feed ads is roughly $10 to $14, with a bit less for Stories and Reels.
facts.quote: Average CPM (cost per thousand impressions):** roughly $10 to $14 for feed ads, a bit less for Stories and Reels

facts.fact: Meta's average price per ad rose 12% year over year in early 2026.
facts.quote: Meta's average price per ad rose 12% year over year in early 2026

facts.fact: Apple's App Tracking Transparency, which let iPhone users opt out of tracking, was introduced in 2021.
facts.quote: Apple's App Tracking Transparency, introduced back in 2021

facts.fact: Benchmark estimates put Facebook ads' average cost per click at around $0.70 for traffic campaigns (vendor-cited, unnamed third-party benchmark).
facts.quote: Benchmark estimates put average cost per click around $0.70 for traffic campaigns

facts.fact: Benchmark estimates put Facebook ads' average cost per click at around $1.92 for leads campaigns (vendor-cited, unnamed third-party benchmark).

facts.quote: with an average cost per lead near $27.66, though costs vary widely by industry and objective

facts.fact: CPMs for Facebook feed ads run roughly $10 to $14 according to the page.
facts.quote: CPMs run roughly $10 to $14 for feed ads.

facts.fact: The page states there is no hard minimum budget for Facebook ads, but advertisers need enough spend to give the algorithm conversion data to learn from.
facts.quote: There's no hard minimum budget, but you need enough spend to give the algorithm conversion data to learn from.
